title: Compatibility with every finite lifted root generator
statement: For the fixed sheaves and generators of [def-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower-data], GeneratorCompatible T ell n d f asserts the prescribed value of f on every scalar-weighted finite etale root tensor and every compatible pro-etale lift. It is precisely the existing predicate, moved without changing its definition.

lean.statement:
def GeneratorCompatible
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (n d : ℕ) (f : (realization T ell n).obj (finiteSheaf T ell n d) ⟶
      quotientLine T ell n d) : Prop
